_comment: WP-VW-W6 W6-CFG — the role / permission matrix of the pharmacy pre-order (MOD-0168) and the price lists + pricing rules (MOD-0156).
ONE source: scripts/rbac/grant_w6_cfg_rbac_97c5.py reads this file; scripts/golive/w6-cfg-grant-roles-live.js carries the same
matrix (scripts/tests/test_w6_cfg_scripts.py fails when the two differ, or when a commercial.* key of the Platform
CrmManifestProvider is neither granted nor listed). A key ending in '.*' is a prefix: every manifest key under it.
K-W6-ROLES (user 2026-10-21): sales operations + four-eyes publishing = Department Manager or Admin (no own role);
workflow_needs_comment: REPORT ONLY — never granted by the W6-CFG scripts (MOD-0023's keys; decision K13). The CRM starts and decides the
approval rounds with the CALLER's token (GatewayClaimWorkflowClient): submit → POST /api/v1/workflow/instances
(instances.start), the approver's task → GET tasks/mine (instances.view), the decision → tasks/{id}/approve|reject.

roles.why: field rep: own pre-orders (draft, sign, submit, cancel) + the CRM reads of the mobile app (CRM-ROLE-1) + the product picker
approving line manager (the Platform line-manager resolver names them as runtime candidates)
approving line manager + sales operations + four-eyes publishing (K-W6-ROLES)
